title: Mechanistic Interpretability of Mambas Selective Gate in Financial Markets: A Leakage-Controlled Study
abstract: arXiv:2611.18599v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Selectively gated state-space models (SSMs), notably Mamba, are increasingly used for financial time series, yet how they internally represent market regimes (bull, bear, sideways) remains opaque. This paper applies Mechanistic Interpretability (MI) to a six-layer Mamba trained on approximately twenty-one years of daily data for a point-in-time set of S&P 500 constituents plus macroeconomic and Fama-French factors, decomposing per-layer hidden states with Top-K Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs). translated_title: 金融市场中选择性门控Mamba模型的机制可解释性：一项泄漏控制研究
translated_abstract: 选择性门控状态空间模型（SSM），尤其是Mamba，在金融时间序列中的应用日益增多，但其内部如何表示市场状态（牛市、熊市、横盘）仍不透明。本文将机制可解释性（MI）应用于一个六层Mamba模型，该模型在约二十一年的每日数据上训练，数据涵盖特定时点的标普500成分股集合以及宏观经济和Fama-French因子，并使用Top-K稀疏自编码器（SAE）对各层隐藏状态进行分解。我们的核心贡献是方法论层面的，且具有警示意义：在先前未受控制的配置下，SAE特征能够以F1 = 1.00的分数恢复市场状态；而在受控协议下——即(i)移除与HMM标签定义重叠的三个输入特征，(ii)禁用辅助的状态分类头，(iii)使用特定时点的成分股集合，(iv)使用与输入不相交的标签进行评估——同样的状态标签恢复结果出现了变化，揭示了先前结果中的信息泄漏问题。
tldr: 本文通过对金融Mamba模型进行泄漏控制的机制可解释性研究，揭示了先前未受控设置下近乎完美的市场状态恢复（F1=1.00）源于信息泄漏，警示此类解释性研究的评估协议设计至关重要。
en_tdlr: This leakage-controlled mechanistic interpretability study of financial Mamba models reveals that near-perfect market regime recovery (F1=1.00) under uncontrolled settings stemmed from information leakage, highlighting the critical importance of evaluation protocol design in interpretability research.
